sources.title: Measuring AI Ability to Complete Long Software Tasks - METR
sources.snippet: Conclusion We believe this work has important implications for AI benchmarks, forecasts, and risk management. First, our work demonstrates an approach to making benchmarks more useful for forecasting: measuring AI performance in terms of the length of tasks the system can complete (as measured by how long the tasks take humans).
